Third-party browser libraries, self-hosted (nothing loads from a public CDN). Copied unchanged from the Toolbox (`shared/vendor/`), which took them unchanged from npm.

| File | Package | Version | Licence |
|---|---|---|---|
| `jspdf.umd.min.js` | jspdf | 2.5.1 | MIT |

Used by the BD report's PDF export, the same library the Scheduler's export uses. The embedded fonts and the Arch Nexus logo it draws are in `shared/export/assets.js`.
